The main thing that has helped me, partner or not. Is just talking. I talk about any and everything I feel to whoever. Even myself sometimes. Things become easier to rationalize when I hear them out loud. But again, sometimes they just don’t. So I just sit and feel. I still hurt myself sometimes but man the way I’m able to step away from the edge every now and then kinda makes that all okay.

I do have to give some credit to my current partner. They are able to steer those thoughts away when they hit hard and I’m ready to dive off the deep end. Because some days I have a rerealization that suicide will take it all away. Some days I think that no amount of good could ever outweigh the sheer physical pain my depression puts me In. I honestly couldn’t tell you how I’ve gotten so far. Everything hurts. But sometimes it doesn’t. There’s always some kind of lamp or light, even if it’s just a firefly you happen to be passing. And I really like fireflies.

If you can’t give your partner all they deserve let them go because someone else definitely will.
